groups.title: 未合并 A2A input-required 跨HTTP托管 feature

source_lifecycle_review: park returns before draining remaining stream and archiving terminal outcome
separate expiry cancellation replaces Policy.Approvals fallback
no bounded live-run capacity or server Close ownership
takeParked/delete paths require concurrent resume/cancel ownership fencing
